title: Images, content pages and e-mail templates
caption: settings/assets, settings/pages, settings/templates (OAD-014, OAD-015); settings-effects.e2e.ts for the page and the broken template.

steps.title: Upload a logo
steps.body: **Upload an image**: "What the image is for" Logo, a PNG under 1 MB (at most 2000 × 2000 pixels), **Upload**.
steps.expect: Listed with type read from the bytes, size, dimensions; pickable in Brand and theme. An SVG or a 1.1 MB file is refused before any call.

steps.title: Create a page
steps.body: Address `about-us`, Language, Title, a Markdown body, "Published on the storefront", "Listed in the storefront footer", **Create page**.
steps.expect: The page opens; **View on storefront** opens `/p/about-us`; the footer links it.

steps.title: A refused body
steps.body: Add raw `<script>` or a `javascript:` link and **Save**.
steps.expect: The message next to the line it names with **Go to line N**; nothing saved.

steps.title: Edit a template
steps.expect: Preview in a sandboxed frame; saved as Customised; `settings.templates.put` staff action.

steps.title: A template that does not compile
steps.body: Leave `{{` unclosed on line 2 of the HTML body, **Save**.
steps.expect: "The template does not compile", "HTML body, line 2" with **Go to line 2**; the row unchanged; a `failed` staff action.

steps.title: Reset
steps.expect: The page says what serves the locale now (its language's row or the code default).
